info.title: Zouriel Workflows REST API
info.description: The API every engine serves under its mount point (MapWorkflowApi in .NET). Exported from the .NET sample app (GET /openapi/v1.json); paths are shown mounted at /api/workflows. Request and response bodies for definitions, registries and settings follow spec/schema/*.json.

tenant.description: The chain it belongs to, or null without tenancy.

actorId.description: The user id, or the instance id for workflows.

actorName.description: The actor's display name (workflow key for workflows).

entity.description: The record's entity, when it concerns a record.

before.description: Masked JSON of the state before.

after.description: Masked JSON of the state after.

correlationId.description: Groups entries of one chain of work.

causationId.description: The instance or entry that caused this one, if known.

prevHash.description: The previous entry's hash (64 zeros for the first).

oneOf.description: The latest published version's JSON, or null.

versions.description: Published versions, newest first, with instance counts.

DefinitionDetail.description: A definition with its draft, latest published version, version history and the draft's lint problems.

key.description: Its key (unique; other workflows and the API use it).

entity.description: The record type it is about, if any.

version.description: The latest published version (0 when never published).

hasDraftChanges.description: True when the draft differs from the latest published version.

updatedAt.description: When the draft or status last changed.

runningInstances.description: Unfinished automation and record instances of any version.

DefinitionSummary.description: A workflow definition in lists (builder home page, API).

instances.description: How many automation and record instances are pinned to it.

DefinitionVersionInfo.description: One published version of a definition.

to.description: The user id to hand the task to.

state.description: The state key to move to.

lifecycle.description: Which lifecycle, when the entity has more than one.
Which lifecycle, when the entity has more than one.

InputBody.description: Body of transition and manual-start requests.

code.description: Stable problem code, the same in every engine and editor (`spec/fixtures/lint`).

node.description: The id of the step, state or transition the problem is on; null for the whole definition.

message.description: What is wrong, in plain words.

LintProblem.description: One problem in a definition. `Node` is the id of the step, state or transition it is on.

stateMap.description: Old state key → new state key, where keys differ.

note.description: What changed, shown in the version list.

ReasonBody.description: A body carrying only a reason (e.g. cancelling an instance).

target.description: Which incident, by token id or failed step id, when several paths stopped (default: the first).

entity.description: The record's entity, if the signal is about one.

outputs.description: Outputs to give the skipped step.

target.description: Which incident, by token id or failed step id, when several paths stopped (default: the first).

type.description: The trigger type (spec §5), or `lifecycle` for an owned field.

entity.description: The record type it watches, if any.

field.description: The field it watches or owns, if any.

summary.description: A plain-English description ("When Application Stage changes to Done").

version.description: The published version the trigger comes from.

TriggerOverview.description: One active trigger or lifecycle, for the "Watching" section of global settings.
